dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2014 general election. This was the first election using a Vote-Anywhere model. Voters can vote at any voting place within the City.

Prior to the 2014 municipal election, the city was divided into voting divisions and voters were required to vote at a designated voting place within their assigned voting division.

The City operates an at-large voting system.

Note:

UBC Lands and UEL residents are only eligible to vote for School Trustees.

Data currency

​These are the voting places used for the City's 2014 municipal elections during Advance Voting and on General Voting Day.

Data accuracy

​Voting places change from election to election and are not directly comparable over time.
